name: hub-rosters-teams
description: A persona from any roster launches with --as roster/name and runs its roster's agent bundle; /hub orgs lists the bundled teams plus a user team from ~/.kollab/teams; an unknown team is refused. Plain kollab (--no-daemon) in a throwaway HOME, no keyring, no model call.

config.command: sh -c 'R=$(pwd); H=$(cat "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-rosters.path"); cd "$H/ws" && HOME="$H" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 exec "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --no-daemon --as marketing-crew/maya'

steps.description: throwaway HOME: a profile that is never called, and a user team
steps.command: P="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-rosters.path"; H=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-rosters.XXXXXX"); printf %s "$H" > "$P"; mkdir -p "$H/.kollab/teams" "$H/ws"; touch "$H/.kollab/connect-guide-seen"; printf '{"application":{"setup_completed":true},"kollabor":{"llm":{"active_profile":"fake","profiles":{"fake":{"provider":"custom","model":"fake-echo","base_url":"http://127.0.0.1:9/v1","api_key":"not-a-real-key"}}}}}' > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; printf '{"name":"duo","description":"Two writers","roster":"marketing-crew","lead":"theo","members":[{"persona":"theo"},{"persona":"jonas","reports_to":"theo"}]}' > "$H/.kollab/teams/duo.json"; echo "throwaway home ready"

steps.description: the hub name is the part after the slash
